change.bullet: - Capture of an input's value into a storing element of this entity, directly or through this entity's register stages, is storage, not unchanged forwarding: the input is a setting point of the concept that element stores. Clock, clock-enable, reset and transport inputs remain excluded.
change.why: the generator forms the concept of a sampled input but credits the register that samples it, never the pin (chance cluster: uart_rxd_i, spi_dat_i, jtag_tms_i, twi_sda_i; difficult: enable_i, jtag_tdi_i, uart_ctsn_i). Seed L13 'reads ... to store it' and L57 'Capturing a value in a register is storage' already say so; L218 'unchanged forwarding' is what the model applies instead. The bullet narrows L218.
change.basis: seed L13, L57, L216; IEEE P3164 3.1.2 (structural assets = the RTL that produces, stores and transports the value) and p8 (a buffer holding data as it enters the IP is structural)
change.review: two Claude agents 2026-10-01 (scratchpad agents3/): attacker revised the draft (dropped 'report the register too': +6.7 FP/run, 0 GT; restated the clock/reset/transport exclusions: 3 + 19 ports would otherwise be admitted); recount reproduced every count (154 whole inputs, 16 captured = 10 GT + 6 non-GT, 8 GT missed in 2+ runs of which 4 covered, 5 under a one-hop reading)

expected_effect_mechanical_bound: per run: +3.3 to +4 GT, +1.7 non-GT (up to +4.3 if the clock/reset exclusion slips); precision 0.355/0.337/0.362, recall 0.892/0.847/0.910 on the winner's runs
pre_registered_readings: hand_arms/read_cap_arm.py (slot counts against the winner); main test: the 4 target GT inputs (jtag_tms_i, spi_dat_i, sys enable_i, uart_rxd_i) are at 2 of 12 run-slots today; the rule is falsified if they reach 4 or fewer of 12
